title: Machine Learning & Data Engineering
jobDescription: Job Description Summary Your role as an Engineering Lead is to be a visionary leader who works collaboratively with others to create an organisation that provides the best value propositions to our customers. You will be responsible for leading a team of up to 20 engineers. You’ll encourage teams to actively take part in Guilds, Inner Source activities and other forums and meet-ups through which our engineering methods and practices can be shared and developed so that new insights and ideas can be brought back to the lab to further improve engineering effectiveness. You’ll have responsibility for hiring and growing existing engineering talent across the engineering teams enabling teams to reach their full potential. You’ll enable a culture of learning and continuous improvement through a “Fail Fast, Learn Faster” mentality within teams to experiment and test new ways of engineering, to act as a change agent for engineering and team culture, and to foster a systems-thinking and user-experience led design approach. Job Description Experience: 16-20 years Location: Hyderabad What you’ll need: Vision and the ability to provide an engineering strategy and roadmap Self-starter who inspires and motivates the teams around you Extensive software engineering background with one or more programming languages Ability to listen and reflect and respect the views of others as well as being able to communicate your own opinion but you are not strongly tied to it Champion an environment where teams are empowered to be autonomous and self-sufficient, and you provide purpose, guidance and support where needed Passionate coach for other engineers to build a strong team culture Ability to work effectively with multi-disciplinary, internal and external geographically distributed teams across the product lifecycle Curious to learn and develop yourself with industry best practice methods and tooling, along with the tools used by their engineering teams, to make valuable contributions in validating team engineering work and decisions Ability to motivate, to challenge the status quo and you have an appreciation and understanding of first principles thinking Demonstrate the following Engineering Principles and Core Values within your work, whilst educating the rest of the team on them. As an Engineer: Understand the business area to facilitate the best solution design with team members and product owners Be environment aware, identify technical impediments / bottlenecks and work directly to resolve Be technology agnostic and willing to adapt approach in pursuit of the best solution Be anchored to core engineering area and carry the ability to test, learn and mentor others Understand Systems Thinking and Service Design to mitigate reactive solutions that leads to further technical debt Understand the benefits of measuring change and work with teams to provide reassurance and mitigate behavioural change Understand agile and the relationship between agile definitions and automated delivery Be passionate about automating everything Be industry aware and understand the importance of new technical approaches to evolve solutions and the experience of the team Knowledge & Experience Strong knowledge of the entire software development lifecycle and experience in end- to- end delivery of software products Significant experience with agile development methods & tooling e.g., Scrum, Kanban, Jira & Confluence, and experience of leading & working as part of an agile team Strong software development background essential, along with knowledge of modern software development toolsets including Dev Ops, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery Key Responsibilities Delivery of Value: A visionary leader who works with the Product Owner, Architects and teams to build an inspiring services engineering strategy that provides inspiration and purpose. Responsible for creating amazing capabilities for our customers using technical expertise to deliver change through modern engineering tools and methods and by inspiring teams to embrace agile principles, encourage innovation, and foster a “Fail Fast, Learn Faster” approach. An inspiring communicator who can work with all levels of the organisation, energising teams and ensuring communication is flowing affectively. Work with the team and the wider Engineering Community to ensure that platforms and software are built consistently with relevant patterns and practices, ensuring a collaborative environment to share ideas and work through complex problems. Compliance and Governance Accountable for ensuring that all Engineering work in is carried out in line with the Bank standards including all decision making. Accountable for maximising the safe delegation of authority and empowerment to the team in line with the above and in line with the core principle of Transformation Creating and Protecting the Culture Look out and hire new talent with a focus on building amazing teams with a collaborative and inclusive culture where teams are empowered to test and learn. Able to nurture teams, support them through a culture of openness and trust, and to make teams the best they can be. You have a strong passion and technical understanding of systems and can provide support, knowledge and mentoring to the teams. This includes helping teams to use the best engineering practices, tooling and methods and to encourage them to contribute towards inner-source activities and attend Meetups. Champion the principles & aims of Transformation to guide and support teams through the Transformational change. Work with Agile Coaches to create opportunities for learning and growth for all. Encourage engineers to join Communities of Practice, Guilds and Working Groups to deliver peer-to-peer mentoring and joint engineering initiatives via coordinated sessions and Inner Source delivery methods. A highly experienced member of our wider Engineering team, and we expect the Engineering Lead to drive exemplary software engineering practices as well as mentor and nurture the talent at all levels of their software engineering community. title: Customer Journey Manager
jobDescription:
Job Description Summary The CJM plays a crucial role in product development; working with the Product Owner and the broader product team in understanding, measuring and orchestrating Customer Journeys with a focus on technology and on integrating across functions. Alongside the rest of the feature team, the CJM plays a key supporting role in making sense of this insight and factoring it into prioritisation approaches and design choices. The CJM is responsible for understanding and optimising the end-to-end customer experience (internal and external) to ensure the needs of the customer remain at the forefront of all journeys. They will be responsible for supporting the continuous improvement of the journey and for orchestrating across functional boundaries to ensure journey effectiveness. This will be achieved through collaborating with colleagues in Product, Experience Design and Engineering to ensure the intended user experience, and journey or process design, is accurately represented. Role

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Understand: • Understands end to end journey with support • Integrates insights and knowledge from disparate data, processes and systems which are relevant to the customer journey • Works with supervision and lead on Customer Journey and process maps (e.g Visio) Optimise: • Continually evaluates the effectiveness of parts of the journey from a customer and business perspective • Often displays a continuous improvement mindset to their journey Orchestration: • Coordinate cross functional alignment on journeys • Understand cross-functional context and build alignment as needed Job Description Uses the knowledge management system to access required information for specific purposes. Works independently to collate and analyse data using pre-determined tools, methods and formats. Identifies shortcomings in existing processes, systems and procedures, then uses established change management programmes to deliver prescribed outcomes and/or provide support services. Accesses required information for specific purposes using the data management system. Organises and prepares complex documents by using multiple computer applications (such as Microsoft Office), while also gathering and summarising data for special reports. Develops personal capabilities using existing formal and informal training opportunities. Processes and responds to a broad range of questions and issues raised through any communications channels (in person, telephone, email, etc.) Responds to individual and team objectives and invests in improving personal performance by growing own skills and capabilities. Delivers prescribed outcomes and/or supports others by carrying out designated research activities using existing systems and protocols. Meets customer needs related to simple products and services while following standardised protocols and/or provides back-office support to a customer advisor team. Supports others by performing prescribed product development/engineering activities (e.g., analysing client situations, interpreting data, etc.) using existing procedures. Expertise in tools such as Dynatrace, CI/CD, GCP cloud deployment, Curl, and Postman. Hands on in Kubernetes and Docker. Preferable to have exposure to Terraform, Istio and Helm charts. Experience with messaging and integration frameworks like JMS, MQ, and Kafka. Analyses and evaluates the feasibility/relevance of proposals for complex products/services. Identifies and evaluates complex expertise-led solutions against a range of criteria to find the ones that best meet business needs. Manages the development and/or operation of knowledge management system with guidance from senior colleagues. Analyses specified problems and issues to find the best technical and/or professional solutions. Strong Communication, Influential and Leadership skills

QUALIFICATIONS:
12+ years of relevant experience in design, development and architecting complex software solutions. 10+ years of experience working as a hands-on software developer end-to-end solution. 6+ year of experience in designing and developing micro-front end and microservices. 6+ years of experience working in large financial services; preferably banking industry 6+ years of Systems Architecture and Application design experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education 4+ years of experience with Google Cloud/ Azure Cloud/ AWS (or comparable CSP) Tech Stack: Primary Skills: Java, J2ee, Spring Boot, Spring Boot Reactive programming, Microservices, REST & SOAP APIs, RDBMS and/ or No-SQL Databases, React JS, Redux, Webpack, Cloud Experience and Kafka. Secondary Skills: Kubernetes, Docker, GKE/ Cloud Run, prior GCP experience, CI/ CD pipelines, Dynatrace/ App Dynamics, Splunk/ Google Cloud Logging, Unix/ Linux. The role focuses on ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and modern, while driving simplification and innovation across the technology landscape. Job Description
1. Design & Delivery Develop end-to-end solution architectures for complex systems within the platform model. Ensure designs meet functional, security, and compliance requirements in line with Group architecture standards. Support delivery teams with planning, estimation, and proactive risk mitigation (e.g., technical debt, currency risks).
2. Strategic Alignment Contribute to quarterly planning activities and technology roadmaps. Identify and recommend modernisation opportunities and adoption of emerging technologies.
3. Collaboration Partner closely with Product Owners, Platform Leads, Enterprise Architects, and Engineering teams. Act as a trusted advisor by translating technical concepts into business-aligned solutions for stakeholders.
4. Governance & Compliance Participate in Architecture Review Committee (ARC) and Architecture Working Group (AWG). Maintain architectural documentation and ensure adherence to security and compliance standards. Required Skills & Competencies Strong expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, API design, and containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes). Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, and Node.js. Deep understanding of architectural patterns including Microservices, CQRS, Event-Driven, and Domain-Driven Design. Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as SAFe, TOGAF, and Agile delivery models. Ability to create detailed technical blueprints and evaluate multiple solution alternatives. Strong problem-solving, leadership, and decision-making capabilities. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 15+ years of overall IT experience. 5+ years of experience in architecture or senior technical leadership roles.
